BETA Close X The Sage Group PLC announced on April 13, 2026, that it purchased 1,170,454 of its ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange and multilateral trading facilities from Morgan Stanley & Co. International plc, as part of its share buyback program initiated on March 2, 2026. The purchases occurred at prices ranging from 816.0000 pence to 845.2000 pence per share, with a volume-weighted average price of 829.7400 pence. All acquired shares will be cancelled. Disclaimer* Sage Group PLC (The) 13 April 2026 THE SAGE GROUP PLC TRANSACTION IN OWN SHARES The Sage Group plc ("Sage" or the "Group") announces today that it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 1 ⁴/₇₇ pence each on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from Morgan Stanley & Co. International plc ("Morgan Stanley"). This is pursuant to the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026 which is expected to end no later than 5 June 2026.
